_note: Seed data for the Phase 4 bracelet leaderboard. SOURCE: public lostark.bible CHARACTER pages (https://lostark.bible/character/{NA|CE}/<name>), read once each with a browser User-Agent, strictly sequentially, at least 3s apart. Raid-statistics endpoints were NOT touched. The data is self-reported: it is whatever the owner's roster last synced to lostark.bible, not a verified snapshot. LOADOUTS: a character page carries one loadout per bible tab — most_recent_raid ('Raid Loadout'), most_recent_chaos_dungeon ('Current Loadout (Chaos Dungeon)') and, for some characters, raid_merged ('Estimated Raid Loadout'). EACH loadout has its own items[] and therefore its own bracelet, so a character can wear a different bracelet in each. Every loadout that has one is decoded and scored here, in loadouts[]. chosenLoadout indexes the one the board ranks: the HIGHEST linesPct, ties going to the loadout bible draws, then raid > est. raid > chaos, then newest. The top-level grade/lines/rawStats/damagePct/linesPct mirror that chosen loadout. RENDERED LOADOUT: the page's own bracelet tooltip draws the loadout with the newest lastUpdated — on all 30 pages read, without exception — which is NOT always the raid one. Reading the rendered DOM alone therefore hands you the chaos-dungeon bracelet whenever a character ran chaos after their last raid. renderedLoadout indexes it; its decode is validated line by line against bible's own words (bibleLines), and biblePct / biblePctDelta compare against THAT loadout, since bible's 'Bracelet Effects +X%' describes it too. SCORING: model/bracelet.js on the CANONICAL DEFAULT profile, normalizeProfile({}) — no per-player knobs. damagePct = whole bracelet (combat traits + effect lines). linesPct = effect lines only, the figure comparable to lostark.bible's own 'Bracelet Effects +X%' (biblePct) and to the 7-9% good / 10%+ near-final benchmark. goldAt1_5M = damagePct x 1,500,000 gold per 1% damage, baseline 0. ROLLS: numRerolls / numTicketRerolls in the payload are the counts USED, not left — 4 and 3 mean a fully-rolled bracelet. rollsRemaining = 4-base / 3-ticket, and matches bible's rendered 'N+M rolls remaining' on all four pages that print it. rerollsLeft keeps its historical name and its historical value (the used counts) so the Worker's /admin/seed reader keeps mapping it onto numRerolls unchanged. KNOWN GAP: linesPct runs about +0.8pp above biblePct across the board, and about -1.5pp BELOW it for bracelets carrying family 14 (Additional Damage / Demon-Archdemon). The default profile sets demonShare=0; at demonShare=1 the family-14 gap disappears (-2.34pp spread collapses to +0.20pp), so bible values that clause at full uptime. type:2 indices 3, 4, 74, 149, 151 and type:3 index 11261 are NOT in model TYPE2_INDEX and were decoded with a local extension map; see notes[] per entry.
_loadoutRule: chosenLoadout = highest linesPct; ties: rendered, then raid > raid_merged > chaos, then newest
